title: Line totals and order total
objective: Calculate each line total from a looked-up price and the quantity, then total the order.
instructions: In D2:D6, work out each line total in KES: use XLOOKUP to find the unit price for the code in column B from the price list in F1:H7, then multiply by the quantity in column C. Fix the price list with $ signs. In D7, use SUM to add the five line totals.
hints: A line total is unit price times quantity. You can write the lookup first and then add * and the quantity cell.
For D2 the formula starts =XLOOKUP(B2,$F$2:$F$7,$H$2:$H$7). The price list code column is F2:F7 and the price column is H2:H7.
Finish D2 with *C2 so the price is multiplied by the quantity, then copy the same pattern into D3:D6.
In D7, =SUM(D2:D6) adds the five line totals.
